<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/bins/{binId}/containers"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The sealed or open containers stowed in the bin (ADR 0045), ordered by LPN (which is unique, so it is both the sort key and the id of the keyset cursor). Empty containers have no bin and are not listed. Keyset-paginated (REST guideline section 3): one page of `{items, nextCursor}`, `limit` (1-500, default 100) and the opaque `cursor` from the previous page's `nextCursor`; `nextCursor` is absent on the last page. Any other query parameter is 400 `unknown-query-parameter`. Side-effect-free.
